title: The Fire-Return Settlement

features.name: the-recurring-market-stall
features.desc-on-touch: A vendor's booth that appears and disappears with the smoke cycles. It always holds the same goods: things half-burned, things half-remembered, things that only exist in ash.

features.name: the-cycle-monument
features.desc-on-touch: A structure of charred wood rebuilt each time the fire passes through. The town recognizes the pattern but never the cause. Each rebuild adds ash to the layer below.

features.name: the-smoke-gossip
features.desc-on-touch: Voices that only exist in the haze. They tell stories that change each time the fire forgets the previous telling. The settlement learns a new history every cycle.

features.name: the-ash-layers
features.desc-on-touch: Ground that tells time in stratum, each band a cycle. You read the settlement's forgetting by counting the ash. Some cycles lasted days. Some lasted decades.

features.name: the-phantom-residents
features.desc-on-touch: Figures that move through smoke only when the fire is near. They perform daily routines that may never have happened outside the haze.

inscription: the town that burns and rebuilds and forgets the cycle each time the ash settles; the fire returns because the town has learned to be born in flame; nothing here remembers that it was ever whole

file.name: Settlement_Records_Smoke_Transcriptions_Cycles_18-34.txt
file.note: Ledger of the town's cycles; entries grow less detailed each fire, as if the act of burning makes memory lighter, less certain of itself.
